principle: Duty determines normal tasks; awareness determines belief; tactics/presentation determine moment-to-moment action; facility condition spreads only actual reports, not exact player location.

duty.description: Assigned job and route. Custody holds posts, patrol/Prison have different axes and speeds.

awareness.description: Local, evidence-limited state. This is not interchangeable with numeric Rust suspicion thresholds.

evidence.description: Source identity retained; one impact or secondhand body report is not proof of visual contact.

action.description: Animation/voice/camera interpretation of actual game state. May change more often than facility security.

facility.description: Raised by evidence transmitted by guards, not a generic cinematic timer or a local unconfirmed suspicious glance.

examples.facility: Caution only if sustained evidence warrants it
Normal or Caution until actually reported
examples.attack: none without sustained direct sight and face alignment
warned and cancellable close-range action only

examples.input: Custody approach while aiming during global alert
examples.attack: no compliant capture; evidence still required

critical_invariants: Duty remains independent of alert/awareness/tactical animation.
Direct observed sight, sound origin, squad sighting, body evidence and injury are explicitly distinct causes.
Only a direct confirmed sighting initiates a .6-second squad sighting radio call and facility Alert.
Radio call uses a saved snapshot of an actual sighting, not coordinates overwritten by later sound.
Body evidence raises Caution and sends location of discovered body, not current Snake position.
A guard needs face alignment and uninterrupted visual confirmation before melee damage.
Striking can be cancelled by breaking LOS, increasing distance or stunning guard.
Alerted custody officers do not offer a routine compliant arrest as a trap.
The previous guard behavior returns to the actual patrol axis, including north/south routes.
Facility conditions modify attention, not visibility through concrete or invulnerability to stealth.
Exploration pacing never fabricates a reported security incident.
Animation and audio callbacks cannot own combat hits, flags or checkpoint state.
known_gaps: No animation-blueprint implementation of these states or authored guard voice barks.
No UE5.7 compile, automation tests, collision, visual-telegraph or novice-player evidence.
Facility security-state timers are presently session runtime values and are not restored as a full world snapshot after save/load.
Navigation remains bounded steering with swept collision, not full NavMesh/path tactical planning.
More nuanced morale, fatigue, chain of command and sector-local radio networks are design work, not committed systems.
Original J2ME encounter geography and patrol assignment have not been source verified.
